title: leucanthemopsis heywoodii
intro: Leucanthemopsis heywoodii, commonly known as the Snowy Woodland Daisy, is a low-growing, evergreen perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemopsis heywoodii include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, which helps in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
